nodes.title: Children of Ursus
nodes.note: Not necessary to understand the main plot, but provides some additional context. The events of this storyline are referenced in Episode 15 though so you might want to check it out.

nodes.title: Operational Intelligence
nodes.note: The stories "The Anonymous Ones' War", "Destroyer", and "Among the Light and the Dust" give more insight into the characters of the main theme, but aren't necessary for the overall plot.

subStories.name: Among the Light and the Dust

nodes.title: Darknights Memoir
nodes.note: Reading Darknights Memoir at this point is almost necessary to understand the actions of a certain character in subsequent main story chapters as it gives a very important backstory for her.

nodes.title: Roaring Flare
nodes.note: Official end to the Reunion Arc.

nodes.title: Preluding Lights
nodes.note: The story "Crushed Earth" provides an epilogue to some members of Reunion. Other stories are unrelated.

nodes.title: Dossoles Holiday
nodes.note: Not directly tied into the main plot, but does resolve some character conflict from the Reunion Arc.

nodes.title: Beyond Here
nodes.note: Only "No Sequel" and "For a Better Self" relate to the main story. Other stories are unrelated to the main plot. Even the relevant stories aren't too important, but do have extra character moments.

nodes.title: A Walk in the Dust
nodes.note: Not overall too important to the main plot but does introduce some characters who will show up later.

nodes.title: A Light Spark in the Darkness
nodes.note: Introduces a recurring side character for the Victoria arc.

nodes.title: Vigilo
nodes.note: Vigilo is mainly foreshadowing a lot of things that will happen in later parts of the story, a lot of characterization and backstory for some of the core Rhodes Island members so still a fairly important read.

nodes.title: Stormwatch
nodes.lead: While not at all necessary, it may be helpful at this point to read the Kazimierz plotline through Near Light to learn a bit more about the Followers.

nodes.title: What the Firelight Casts
nodes.note: Directly related to main story events. Ties Episode 9 back into the rest of the arc. Events of this side story are directly referenced in Episode 12.

nodes.title: See You Soon
nodes.note: See You Soon takes place in the middle of Episode 14, providing more details about the goings on of the war.

nodes.title: Ending a Grand Overture
nodes.note: Concludes the character arcs of several major characters in the Victoria arc.

nodes.title: When Elegies are Ashes
nodes.note: Direct sequel to What the Firelight Casts, but also concludes major story threads from Episodes 9 through 14 and See You Soon.

nodes.title: A Kazdelian Rescue
nodes.note: Not at all necessary to understand future plotlines, this is just if you want to see what happens to Kazdel after the war.

nodes.title: Babel
nodes.note: Very important backstory about all the major characters of the arc needed to understand Episode 14.

nodes.title: Dissociative Recombination
nodes.lead: The story kind of assumes from here you've already read Lone Trail and Path of Life. Of the two, Lone Trail is recommended since the more confusing parts of Episode 15 (and Episode 16 references it as well) will make much more sense if you've read it. Path of Life is skippable but nice to have.
nodes.note: The first couple of nodes finish up Arc 2 but the majority of it is the start of Arc 3.

nodes.title: Abnormal Spectrum
nodes.lead: Major characters from Arc 3 show up in The Masses Travel, so it might be recommended to read it before moving on to Episode 16. However, it doesn't tie into Episode 16's plot in any major way, so you can skip it and still be fine.

nodes.title: Grani and the Knights' Treasure
nodes.note: Introduces one of the lead characters of the storyline, as well as an important macguffin.

nodes.title: Beyond Here
nodes.note: Only "For a Better Self" is related to this plotline, all other stories in this collection are unrelated. Doesn't have much but does have a little extra characterization for an important character in Under Tides.

nodes.title: Under Tides
nodes.note: The formal introduction to the main conflict of the storyline.

nodes.title: Preluding Lights
nodes.note: The story "Forgotten Lighthouse" helps bridge the gap between Under Tides and Stultifera Navis. Other stories are unrelated.

nodes.title: Stultifera Navis
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Under Tides.

nodes.title: Mizuki and Caerula Arbor
nodes.note: Not directly tied into the main plot but has a lot of interesting lore. Only the first ending is canon.

nodes.title: Path of Life
nodes.lead: At this point the story assumes you've read both Lone Trail and Episode 14. Path of Life will spoil certain plot points from them (especially Lone Trail), so it might be wise to read them before continuing.
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Stultifera Navis.

nodes.title: Exodus from the Pale Sea
nodes.note: Not really related to the main plot of the Seaborn plotline at all but it takes place in the same general setting so I'm including it here. It might also be relevant later on.

nodes.title: Ancient Forge
nodes.note: Introduces some of the relevant characters for the storyline.

nodes.title: Who is Real
nodes.note: Beginning of the main plot of this storyline.

nodes.title: Invitation to Wine
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Who is Real.

nodes.title: To Be Continued
nodes.note: The story "Until Next Time" has some additional events that take place in between Invitation to Wine and Where the Vernal Wind Never Blows. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

nodes.title: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Invitation to Wine.

event.name: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow

nodes.title: A Death in Chunfen
nodes.note: An interquel focusing on one of the side characters from Where the Vernal Winds Never Blows. A mostly self contained story with limited impact on the overall storyline.

nodes.title: Here a People Sows
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Where the Vernal Wind Never Blows.

nodes.title: Such Is The Joy of Our Reunion
nodes.lead: At this point I recommend having read the main story through Episode 6 since a major character from Episode 6 features heavily in Such Is The Joy of Our Reunion.
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Here a People Sows.

event.name: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion

nodes.title: Fantasy in the Mirage
nodes.note: I'm not 100% sure how this ties into the main Sui storyline, since it doesn't resolve the cliffhanger from the end of Such Is The Joy of Our Reunion, so I'm going to leave it as "required" for now, but might make it optional depending on what happens in the next main Sui event.

nodes.title: Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Fantasy in the Mirage. All endings are canon.

nodes.title: Maria Nearl
nodes.note: Start of the plotline.

nodes.title: Pinus Sylvestris
nodes.note: Introduces many characters that will be important in Near Light.

nodes.title: Near Light
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Maria Nearl.

nodes.title: To Be Continued
nodes.note: The story "Farewell Roy" serves as a bonus epilogue to Near Light. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

nodes.title: An Obscure Wanderer
nodes.note: An epilogue serving to tie up some unfinished plot threads from Near Light.

nodes.title: Operational Intelligence
nodes.note: The story "After-class Homework" introduces a couple of the core characters, so it might be worth a read before starting. Other stories are unrelated.

nodes.title: Mansfield Break
nodes.note: Serves to set up many of the main characters of the plotline.

nodes.title: To Be Continued
nodes.note: The story "True Story" serves as a transition to connect Mansfield Break to Dorothy's Vision. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

nodes.title: Dorothy's Vision
nodes.note: Beginning of the main conflict.

nodes.title: Lone Trail
nodes.lead: It's recommended to read Episode 7 and Episode 8 before starting Lone Trail since it continues the arc of one of the major characters from those main story episodes.
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Dorothy's Vision.

nodes.title: Unrealized Realities
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Lone Trail.

nodes.title: Code of Brawl
nodes.lead: It may be helpful to read Episode 2 and Episode 3 before starting this plotline as Penguin Logistics is formally introduced there.
nodes.note: Sets up several of the characters that will be relevant to the plotline.

nodes.title: To Be Continued
nodes.note: The story "Wolf and Wolfpack" serves as a transition to connect Code of Brawl to Il Siracusano. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

nodes.title: Il Siracusano
nodes.lead: While not entirely necessary, it might be helpful to read the main theme through Episode 6 before starting Il Siracusano since the epilogue of the story directly references events from it.
nodes.note: Start of the main conflict.

nodes.title: I Portatori dei Velluti
nodes.lead: Read up through Episode 8 of the main story before continuing, I Portatori dei Velluti will spoil its biggest twist.
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Il Siracusano.

nodes.title: Code of Brawl
nodes.lead: It may be helpful to read Episode 2 and Episode 3 before starting this plotline as Penguin Logistics is formally introduced there.
nodes.note: Sets up several of the characters that will be relevant to the Laterano plotline.

nodes.title: Guide Ahead
nodes.note: Start of the Laterano plotline.

nodes.title: Preluding Lights
nodes.note: The story "Different" introduces the Witch King conflict. Other stories are unrelated.

nodes.title: Lingering Echoes
nodes.note: Start of the Leithanien plotline.

nodes.title: Hortus de Escapismo
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Guide Ahead.

nodes.title: Zwillingstürme im Herbst
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Lingering Echoes, but also contains story elements from Hortus de Escapismo.

nodes.title: The Masses Travel
nodes.lead: You should definitely read Episode 15 before starting The Masses Travel, it directly ties into it.
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Hortus de Escapismo, but also contains story elements from Zwillingstürme im Herbst and Episode 15.

nodes.title: Preluding Lights
nodes.lead: I recommend reading the Kazimierz plotline before starting the Kjerag plotline due to some overlapping characters.
nodes.note: The story "Letter" explains how Rhodes Island got involved in Break the Ice. Other stories are unrelated.

nodes.title: Break the Ice
nodes.note: The start of the plotline.

nodes.title: To Be Continued
nodes.note: The story "Browntail" has some additional events that take place in between Break the Ice and The Rides to Lake Silberneherze. All other stories in this collection are unrelated.

nodes.title: The Rides to Lake Silberneherze
nodes.lead: I recommend reading the Main Theme through Episode 12 before continuing as it's necessary to understand the central conflict of The Rides to Lake Silberneherze.
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Break the Ice.

nodes.title: Retracing Our Steps
nodes.lead: It's recommended that you read the Rhine Lab plotline at this point as Retracing Our Steps kind of assumes you've read Lone Trail.
nodes.note: Direct sequel to The Rides to Lake Silberneherze.

nodes.title: Heart of Surging Flame
nodes.note: Start of the plotline.

nodes.title: Code of Brawl
nodes.note: Not part of the overall plotline but introduces characters that will be important for So Long, Adele.

nodes.title: So Long, Adele
nodes.lead: At this point I recommend reading the main theme through Episode 5 in order to get introduced to a certain character that will be important in So Long, Adele.
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Heart of Surging Flame.

nodes.title: The Great Chief Returns

nodes.title: Ideal City: Endless Carnival
nodes.note: Direct sequel to The Great Chief Returns.

event.name: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun

nodes.title: Twilight of Wolumonde
nodes.note: The bulk of this plotline is here.

nodes.title: Rewinding Breeze
nodes.note: The story "Recollection" serves as an epilogue to Twilight in Wolumonde. The other stories are unrelated.

nodes.title: Rewinding Breeze
nodes.note: The story "Crisscrossing Shadows" serves as the introduction to this plotline. The other stories are unrelated.

nodes.title: Phantom & Crimson Solitaire
nodes.note: The first major entry in this plotline. All endings are canon.

nodes.title: Act or Die
nodes.note: Direct sequel to Phantom and Crimson Solitaire.

nodes.note: The story "Polaris" introduces two of the core characters of the plotline. The other stories are unrelated.
